#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k > 1) {
        long long order = 1;
        long long current = k % p;
        while (current != 1 && order < p) {
            current = (current * k) % p;
            order++;
        }
        long long exponent = (p - 1) / order;
        cout << modPow(p, exponent, MOD) << endl;
    } else if (k == 1) {
        cout << modPow(p, p, MOD) << endl;
    } else if (k == 0) {
        cout << modPow(p, p - 1, MOD) << endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}

const long long MOD = 1000000007;

long long mulMod(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    long long exponent;
    
    if (k > 1) {
        auto computeOrder = [&](long long base, long long mod) -> long long {
            long long val = 1;
            for (long long ord = 1; ord <= mod; ++ord) {
                val = (val * base) % mod;
                if (val == 1) return ord;
            }
            return mod;
        };
        long long ord = computeOrder(k, p);
        exponent = (p - 1) / ord;
    } else if (k == 1) {
        exponent = p;
    } else {
        exponent = p - 1;
    }
    
    long long result = 1;
    for (long long i = 0; i < exponent; ++i) {
        result = mulMod(result, p);
    }
